name: @etzhayyim/open-swift-kotoba
description: kotoba reference implementation of open-swift (ISO 20022 interbank messaging: institution BIC directory + pacs.008 message envelopes) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS (replaces D1). Routing/UETR/status only; account-level PII stays off-substrate. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000.
